notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.content: [list][*][p]Increased Traffic Variety: Added more traffic vehicles, including cars, campers and trucks.[/p][/*][*][p]New In-Game Shop: Introducing a Shop where you can purchase and unlock playable vehicles, new highways, and video effects.[/p][/*][*][p]New Score System: A new scoring system based on time, speed, and other factors has been introduced. Your score now converts into cash, which can be spent in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Checkpoint System Update: Checkpoints no longer add time. Instead, they now contribute the remaining time to your score and grant a fixed time bonus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Equalizer Effect Button State: The "Equalizer Effect" button now correctly reflects whether the building equalizer lines are enabled or disabled.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added new camera views: Bonnet Cam, Bumper Cam, and an additional Far Chase Cam for a wider perspective[/p][/*][*][p]Selected camera view is now saved between sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Some camera views now have a wider field of view to enhance the sensation of speed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause an unexpected instant game over[/p][/*][*][p]Steering sensitivity is now adjustable in the settings[/p][/*][/list]
